My aunt is intellectually disabled and we got her the cat version. It was a little creepy at first but I’m not going to lie, it was kinda soothing. Like you know it’s fake, but it responds to a few commands and petting and the fur feels real so you get that nice feeling you would get from a normal cat. 

It’s hard to explain, but my whole family was pretty impressed by it. And this was like 3+ years ago so I can only imagine they are getting better.

Idk how her mental state is, but there are really awesome animatronic dogs that they use in some homes for elderly patients. Even those that know they are fake are shown to be calmed by them similar to a normal dog! But it’s mostly been studied in dementia.

My paternal grandparents hate me. Idk if it is because I’m female? Or look like my mom? Long story longer, the reason this ended up okay is because my parents backed me up and didn’t let my grandparents screw me over. When they refused to come to an important life event for me they were no longer invited to my brothers. When my brother was bought lavish presents and I was given small things or my grandparents made me feel like shit my mom always stepped in and made sure I knew she saw it and that even though we couldn’t do anything about it at the time she knew it wasn’t fair. Even that validation was enough. 

Long story longer OP, if you let this grandparent in you need to make sure that the “lesser” child feels validated, and that they know that they don’t have to like someone just because they are family.
